svg.text: Route: /admin/raw-materials?tab=movements · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• One log of every stock change, newest first, for raw materials and ready-made items together (GET /api/inventory/movements): sales (a dish's raw materials, a ready-made item's pieces),
restocks, corrections, spoilage and cancelled orders put back, with who made each change and why. It replaced the separate logs on the Raw materials and Ready-made tabs.
• Filters: Show (raw materials, ready-made items or both), Item (one raw material or ready-made item), Change (sales, restocks, other adjustments) and From / To (Manila dates, both
included); Clear filters resets them. Up to the latest 150 are shown. A ready-made item's sale shows the pieces sold, but not the count before and after, which isn't recorded.
